summary: Codex implementation of VS-012/VS-013 adversarial review fixes. Major blockers addressed: unified Choyce color palette applied to all materials, primitive bridge replaced with authored Kenney model, water mesh subdivision increased to 256x256, shore/depth treatment added via shader parameters, and contact shadows enabled for object grounding. Remaining items deferred: terrain-conforming path planes (requires Terrain3D integration), vegetation density gradient, HUD chrome visibility timing, and first-action affordance UX. All implemented changes respect hexagonal architecture boundaries and maintain backward compatibility.
